name.en: SD Gundam BB Warrior Tokugawa Ieyasu Gundam Jet Black Armor Version

description.ja: この商品は 当サイト及び「模型の世界首都 静岡ホビーフェア」（東静岡）内の‘ホビーミュージアム’でも販売しております。
description.en: This product is also sold on this website and at the 'Hobby Museum' in the 'World Capital of Models Shizuoka Hobby Fair' (Higashi Shizuoka).

description.ja: ガンプラ３０周年記念スペシャルアイテム！
ＢＢ戦士徳川家康頑駄無が漆黒の鎧版で登場！
description.en: BB warrior Tokugawa Ieyasu Gundam is now available in jet black armor!

description.ja: “関ヶ原の戦いで着用し勝利をおさめたといわれる縁起のいい具足をまとったイメージ”の仕様です！！
description.en: The specifications are “an image of the auspicious armor worn at the Battle of Sekigahara and said to have brought victory”! !

description.ja: ●前立や刀のツバは煌びやかな‘金メッキ’仕立て！
description.en: -The front and sword brim are glitteringly 'gold-plated'!

description.ja: ●‘歯朶具足（しだぐそく）’のイメージをＳＤガンダムアレンジ
description.en: ●SD Gundam arrangement of the image of 'Sidagusoku'
- His beloved horse Hakukoou is also included.

description.ja: • 組み立て式プラモデル（接着剤不要）
description.en: • Assembly type plastic model (no adhesive required)
• Target age: 8 years old and above

description.ja: • 武器・足軽兵暴留・のぼり・シール付属
description.en: • Weapons, foot soldiers, banners, and seals included.
